prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Graphite and Aqua: page #F7FBFC, text #233338, accent #006C78, secondary surface #C9F0ED, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in EB Garamond; institutional sans heading with literary body. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
